recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片可見大小不一的紅血球：部分為較小、中央淡染的低色素細胞，部分為較大、色澤飽滿的細胞，另見少數淚滴狀與拉長的紅血球；兩群紅血球並存（dimorphic）是缺鐵性貧血接受鐵劑治療後的常見表現，大量鋸齒狀細胞則多為製片假影。
features: Marked anisocytosis with coexisting smaller hypochromic and larger normochromic red cells
Many crenated red cells (echinocytes), consistent with preparation artifact
Small platelets and a few platelet clumps in background
No nucleated red cells, basophilic stippling or leukocytes in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisocytosis with two red cell populations: smaller hypochromic cells with widened central pallor and larger, well-hemoglobinized cells. Occasional teardrop and elongated forms are present, and many cells are crenated, most likely due to a slide preparation artifact. Platelets are present with small clumps. No nucleated red cells or basophilic stippling are identified in this field. In a patient receiving iron supplementation, the findings are consistent with a dimorphic red cell picture of treated iron deficiency.

ddx.vs: Sideroblastic anemia shows dimorphic cells with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts, and ferritin is high rather than low.
Transfused normocytic cells mimic a dimorphic smear and are identified by clinical history.
MDS shows dimorphic red cells with dysplastic neutrophils (hypogranulation, pseudo-Pelger) and cytopenias in other lineages.
